description: This file defines a utility function 'formatStatusLabel' that converts raw deployment status codes into human-readable labels for display purposes. It handles null/undefined inputs, replaces underscores and hyphens with spaces, collapses multiple spaces, and converts the text to Title Case while preserving apostrophes.

methods.name: formatStatusLabel(value)
methods.description: Converts a raw status code string into a human-readable, title-cased label, handling null values, special characters, and formatting rules.
